title: Final Answer for (a)
description: Essential Criteria - The correct expression for beta must be provided as beta = (E - epsilon) / (E + epsilon).

title: Final Answer for (b)
description: Essential Criteria - The minimum energy E must be calculated correctly as E = m_e^2 / epsilon.

title: Momentum Conservation
description: Important Criteria - The student should demonstrate understanding of momentum conservation in the photon collision.

title: Energy Conservation
description: Important Criteria - The student should apply energy conservation principles correctly in the context of the problem.

title: Invariant Mass Calculation
description: Important Criteria - The student must correctly set up the invariant mass equation for the system.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria - Watch for common sign mistakes in the momentum and energy equations.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria - Ensure that all units are consistent, particularly when calculating energies in eV and GeV.

title: Threshold Energy Understanding
description: Optional Criteria - The student could explain the significance of threshold energy for particle production.
